name: Origin story
summary: First-person Barny episodes from libraries/story-bank.md. The only pillar that may mention 75 Hard.
slide_pattern: cover (the moment, in the founder's voice) → statement (the specific scene) → statement or photo-top (the lesson) → cta
extra_voice_rules: First person as Barny. No 'we'. No 'the brand'.
Specific beats general. 'I bought a four-pack of Arnott's biscuits and ate three in the car' beats 'I struggled with my eating habits'.
Self-deprecating, a bit daft. The voice.md 'Tone on the wire' rule applies.
75 Hard may appear in this pillar only. No 'FIT50 is like 75 Hard' or 'not 75 Hard'.
extra_checks: The post must reference at least one episode from libraries/story-bank.md.
Any scene or line in the post must be paraphrased or quoted from the bank, not invented.
Phrases from the on-brand list in voice.md are encouraged; banned phrases always fail.
